texts.title: Ramp
texts.tagline: Buy and sell stablecoins. In your app.
texts.description: Give your CEX or DEX users a PHP fiat deposit and withdrawal channel without sending them off-platform. Stablecoin rails, faster, lower cost, 24/7. Coins handles compliance.
texts.who: CEXs and DEXs adding a PH fiat channel for their users without the licenses, rails, or compliance lift.

what: Supplementary fiat deposit and withdrawal channel for your exchange.
Live: PHP fiat, BRL fiat, USDC and USDT crypto.
PH payment methods: InstaPay, PESONet, UnionBank, GCash, Maya.
Tiered KYC, MFA, and AML handled by Coins.
